title: NZBGet
wrapper_note:
the upstream image boots with the s6-overlay v3 init, whose service manager
runs as root; with user "1000:1000" nothing starts and port 6789 stays closed.
src/entrypoint.sh performs the same first-run setup as the image's init
(copy the default nzbget.conf, drop a stale lock) and runs the same binary the
s6 service runs, directly as the unprivileged container user.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper** (not a privilege shim): the s6 service manager of the image needs root, so `src/entrypoint.sh` seeds the default `nzbget.conf` and starts NZBGet directly as the unprivileged container user.
user_mode_text: 上游镜像以 s6 管理服务且需要 root，入口包装改为直接以 uid 1000 运行 NZBGet
user_mode_cons:
- 上游镜像用 s6-overlay v3 管理服务，`user: "1000:1000"` 时 s6 无法启动 nzbget，
  容器 Up 但 6789 无人监听。因此 `src/entrypoint.sh` 复刻镜像 init 的首次初始化，
  再以容器用户执行镜像自带的 `/app/nzbget/nzbget`。
- NZBGet 自身不需要 root：配置、队列、日志都在 /config 卷内，实测非 root 下网页正常。
healthcheck_note: 探测首页 `/`，NZBGet 能应答即健康（首次启动生成 nzbget.conf，60s 宽限）。
descript: NZBGet is a lightweight Usenet downloader written in C++. It downloads NZB files, verifies and repairs them with PAR2, unpacks the result and keeps a queue you can manage from a web UI - ideal for small NAS boxes because it needs very little memory and CPU. This package runs the LinuxServer.io Docker image as a non-root container and keeps the configuration, queue and downloads in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed if missing); add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Open the app and add your Usenet server. The default login has no password - set ControlUsername / ControlPassword before exposing the port. Configuration, queue and downloads live in the application data folder; back it up before uninstalling with data removal. TOS Docker applications cannot see shared folders: downloads stay under DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker/downloads.
release_note: 1. First release: NZBGet 26.3 from the LinuxServer.io Docker Hub image, running as a non-root container. Configuration, queue and downloads are kept in the application data folder.
data_notes: `config/` holds `nzbget.conf` (servers, paths, categories, control login) plus the queue database, `queue/` and `tmp/`; `downloads/` receives the finished files. Logs go to the container output (`docker logs nzbgetdocker`). Copying the `nzbgetdocker` folder is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Non-root by construction.** The s6 service manager of the image needs root, so the wrapper seeds the default config and starts the NZBGet binary directly as `1000:1000`; verified on real hardware.
**Fixed image tag `26.3.20261106`** (NZBGet publishes dated builds), Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no `cap_add`, no Docker socket.
**Health check** on the UI (`GET /` on port 6789) with a 60 s start period.
limitations: NZBGet has no default web login: anyone on your LAN can open it. Set ControlUsername and ControlPassword in `nzbget.conf` (or Settings → Security) before exposing the port.

TOS Docker applications cannot mount shared folders: downloads stay in `/Volume1/DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker/downloads/`. Move them out with File Manager, or edit `/Volume1/@apps/DockerEngine/application/nzbgetdocker/docker-compose.yml` after installation.
The UI is served over plain HTTP on the LAN. Do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.

zh-cn.descript: NZBGet 是用 C++ 写的轻量 Usenet 下载器：下载 NZB、用 PAR2 校验修复、自动解压，并提供可管理的网页队列；内存与 CPU 占用很低，适合 NAS。本应用以非 root 容器运行 LinuxServer.io 的镜像，配置、队列与下载都保存在应用数据目录中。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会提示安装）。镜像安装时从 Docker Hub 拉取，无法直连请先配置镜像加速。打开后填写 Usenet 服务器（可选索引站或 *arr 集成）。默认没有网页登录密码——请设置 ControlUsername / ControlPassword，或只在局域网内使用。配置、队列与下载在应用数据目录，卸载并删除数据前请先备份。TOS 的 Docker 应用访问不到共享文件夹：下载文件留在 DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker/downloads，除非你自行编辑 docker-compose.yml。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首次发布：来自 LinuxServer.io Docker Hub 镜像的 NZBGet 26.3，以非 root 容器运行；配置、队列与下载保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: NZBGet 是用 C++ 寫的輕量 Usenet 下載器：下載 NZB、用 PAR2 校驗修復、自動解壓，並提供可管理的網頁佇列；記憶體與 CPU 佔用很低，適合 NAS。本應用以非 root 容器執行 LinuxServer.io 的映像，設定、佇列與下載都保存在應用資料目錄中。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會提示安裝）。映像安裝時從 Docker Hub 下載，無法直連請先設定映像加速。開啟後填寫 Usenet 伺服器（可選索引站或 *arr 整合）。預設沒有網頁登入密碼——請設定 ControlUsername / ControlPassword，或只在區域網路內使用。設定、佇列與下載在應用資料目錄，解除安裝並刪除資料前請先備份。TOS 的 Docker 應用存取不到共享資料夾：下載檔案留在 DockerAppData/nzbgetdocker/downloads，除非你自行編輯 docker-compose.yml。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首次發佈：來自 LinuxServer.io Docker Hub 映像的 NZBGet 26.3，以非 root 容器執行；設定、佇列與下載保存在應用資料目錄。
